name: Always-On Miter Assistant
objective: Build one supported, continuously cycling and recoverable PeTTa/MeTTa organism usable through Mattermost for general conversation, scoped Continuity of Mind, sustained undertakings, meaningful epistemic growth, earned skill acquisition and autonomous expressed-Soul repair, with every phase extending the same persistent runtime.
end_to_end_spine: Continuity of Mind projection and authorized retrieval
actual result and consequence in append-only trajectory
durable continuation, restart and later re-expression

phases.name: Persistent assistant spine and operator plane
phases.integrated_delta: One supported service entry point with install/bootstrap, start, status, stop, panic, evidence export, heartbeat, last-known-good recovery, crash-loop containment and central non-secret configuration.
phases.successor_unlocked: AMA-1.2 general contact and Continuity of Mind

phases.name: General contact and Continuity of Mind
phases.integrated_delta: General held-out dialog and full scoped continuity through the persistent runtime across restart, long gaps, service degradation, principals, projects, duplicates and edits.
phases.successor_unlocked: AMA-1.3 causal Soul navigation using real integrated encounters

phases.name: Causal Soul navigation in the running assistant
phases.integrated_delta: Interconnected flourishings and inherited mathematics construct and compare live alternatives in unfamiliar encounters without situation rules, prompt answers or host-selected behavior.
phases.successor_unlocked: AMA-1.4 faithful endogenous growth and skill acquisition

phases.name: Epistemic growth and open-ended skill acquisition
phases.integrated_delta: Provenance-qualified new relations change later cognition, and multiple held-out missing skills are learned/built, trialed, reused and transferred through the same organism.
phases.successor_unlocked: AMA-1.5 substantive weave and plasticity for regeneration

phases.name: Autonomous regenerative Soul and catastrophic recovery
phases.integrated_delta: No-human semantic recovery of damaged expressed Soul plus independent mechanical recovery from freeze, corrupt activation and crash loops.

phases.name: SNET evaluation release
phases.integrated_delta: A non-builder can install, configure, operate, evaluate, stop, recover and inspect the same Miter organism with honest limits.
phases.successor_unlocked: AMA-1.7 Local Surface Protocol and workbench

phases.name: Local Surface Protocol and composable web workbench
phases.integrated_delta: Versioned declarative surfaces compose around the same undertakings and Soul without acquiring ungranted capabilities or creating another cognitive sovereign.

integrated_closure_law: Except for quarantined pre-promotion trials, no component or phase is complete until its promoted form is reachable through the supported persistent Miter runtime and is exercised through the end-to-end assistant path.

initial_phase.next_action: Inventory exact promoted G33 components, then freeze the service entry contract, lifecycle state machine, runtime-root decision, supervisor boundary, central configuration schema and offline end-to-end smoke path before runtime implementation.

live_authority.required_before_activation: A separate C-098/S-1310 grant with exact principals, surfaces, information exposure, effects, model disclosure, persistence, lifetime, renewal, panic, rollback, revocation and evidence handling.

non_claims: No live or ongoing Mattermost authority is granted by this plan.
No finite test proves universal human-skill acquisition.
No current evidence proves a final Soul or complete flourishing mathematics.
No system can regenerate information after destruction of every authoritative source and recoverable weave.
No unrestricted generated-code, filesystem, network, credential, memory or external-effect authority is granted.
No new runtime root or ~/.miter creation/chown is authorized.
No historical G01-G33 claim is retroactively enlarged.
